messages:
ria: quick follow-up from the PM: we need a more deterministic rollout safety model after last week's outage. thinking: tiered rollback + quota kill-switch + telemetry bucketing.

ria: Proposed short action list:
- T1: Tiered rollback policy (owner: jon) - rollback levels: immediate, staged, delayed; include SLO bumpers
- T2: Kill-switch matrix (owner: kevin) - per-service runtime quotas + emergency toggle mapping
- T3: Telemetry bucketing (owner: nina) - attach percent-exposed + cohort metrics to each rollout for anomaly detection
- T4: Release checklist enforcement (owner: ria) - block on missing scope justification and smoke results

ria: Please ack, give ETA (days) + acceptance criteria. aim: first drafts within two weeks.

jon: ack. tiered rollback makes sense. ETA 9 days to produce policy doc + unit tests. Acceptance: policy can be simulated against replay traffic and will select correct rollback level given defined signals.

kevin: kill-switch matrix ok. ETA 6 days for a minimal runtime quota implementation and an emergency toggle UI. Acceptance: toggles wired to circuit-breaker that reduces traffic to 0 for flagged variant within 30s of activation.

nina: telemetry bucketing: I can add percent-exposed labels and cohort histograms. ETA 7 days. Acceptance: rollouts show cohorted latency/error/budget in dashboards and trigger anomaly markers when deviation > 3 sigma.

sam: release checklist: I'll add pipeline gating to require scope justification and smoke pass. ETA 3 days. Acceptance: pipeline fails deploy when fields missing or smoke-check fails for non-trivial code/model changes.

ria: notes: 1) jon - ensure staged rollback doesn't oscillate for low-volume cohorts (min-window + hysteresis). 2) kevin - limit toggles to owner-approved roles and require reason.

jon: will add hysteresis and min-sample threshold; also provide a simulator harness.

kevin: will add role check + reason field. will also add an audit log export for compliance.

nina: for anomaly detection, do we want weekly baseline refresh?

ria: yes, baseline refresh weekly; include a delta + confidence band in alert. prioritize signals that correlate with user-facing errors.

ops-bot: link created: EPIC-4999; subtasks T1,T2,T3,T4 added. Sprint tag: rollout-hardening.

ria: let's schedule a 30m design review next Tue 9am PT to walk through docs and run the simulator. who can join?

jon: I'll be there.

kevin: can make it.

nina: yes.

sam: me too.

ria: great. owners update EPIC-4999 subtasks with exact acceptance criteria + rough PR plan by Friday EOD. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: reminder: three-day follow-up reminder set. Next check-in in 3 days.
_meta: Synthetic Slack thread about postmortem follow-ups: rollout safety improvements (tiered rollback, kill-switch matrix, telemetry bucketing, release checklist).
